kind: host simulation; NPU/CPU bindings mocked, real paired vocabularies and reference vectors

outcomes.name: TinyBERT default is lazy, with its own thresholds and vocabulary
Every manual bucket is isolated and switching models releases old NPU handles
Automatic routing chooses the smallest fitting bucket; manual overflow is rejected
Failed forced bucket uses same-model CPU, without silently trying a larger NPU bucket
Automatic route can recover from a failed small NPU bucket
Switch metadata failure preserves the previous working model
NPU acceptance covers 27/33/33 actual paired vectors, fresh sessions, and no CPU calls
Acceptance rejects nan outputs and still checks the other buckets
Acceptance rejects short outputs and still checks the other buckets
Acceptance rejects labels outputs and still checks the other buckets
Acceptance rejects drift outputs and still checks the other buckets
A RunSync failure during timed runs cannot yield acceptance pass
Cleanup failure preserves the original inference validation error
Reported 26/27 and 30/33 failure pattern retains original case IDs and per-label margins
Interrupted self-test exports the last failed case and previous successful results
Unavailable system metadata cannot suppress or fabricate the NPU result
Missing NPU cannot pass acceptance through CPU fallback
Truncated or LFS-pointer model asset fails before native load
Incomplete reference coverage cannot pass even when all remaining labels match
Invalid numeric tolerance is rejected at catalog load
Concurrent switch, acceptance and benchmark cannot race an active inference
Single-profile generated catalog needs no MiniRBT or baseline assets
